sample_unit: patients surveyed (plus 168 dietitian reviews of ChatGPT responses and exam questions)

links.outcome: LLM performance on dietitian exam and expert-reviewed responses to common medical nutrition therapy questions
links.effect: ChatGPT and GPT 4.0 passed the Chinese Registered Dietitian exam; dietitians rated 162 of 168 ChatGPT responses favorably; recommendations mostly aligned except root vegetables and dry beans.
links.quote: Professional dietitians' reviews of ChatGPT's responses to common questions were largely positive, with 162 out of 168 providing favorable reviews.

screen.reason: Preclinical concept validation evaluating LLMs on a professional dietitian exam, comparing LLM answers to dietitians' answers, and benchmarking an image recognition model for food identification.
